Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii financiare
Who we are 
 Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.
 The opportunity 
 As a Senior Cloud DevOps Engineer, you will play a crucial role in implementing the project to integrate our Issuing applications on Public Cloud (GCP & AWS) environment. You will lead the DevOps stream, automate our software development and deployment processes, and ensure the reliability, security, stability, and scalability of our systems.
 If you are a dynamic and forward-thinking individual who is passionate about using technology to enhance system performance and reliability, we want to hear from you. Join our team and be part of a company dedicated to pushing technological boundaries and achieving excellence. Apply now to be our Senior Cloud DevOps Engineer and take the next step in your career.
 Day-to-day responsibilities 
Define and manage infrastructure as code using tools like Terraform or Ansible
Package and deploy applications using container technologies like Docker and container orchestration platforms like Kubernetes
Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines
Improve & tune platform delivery & configuration in order to cope with expected volumes, traffic peak, resiliency requirements, security & regulation standards
Set up monitoring and alerting systems to ensure proactive issue detection
Support SRE (during business hours) & collect their requirement to improve service delivery
Integrate security practices into the DevOps process
Foster collaboration and communication between development and operations teams
Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks
Manage version control systems to track changes in code and configuration files
 Who are we looking for 
 Key Skills: 
Strong knowledge of cloud platforms such as Google Cloud and AWS, Azure
Experience with production on critical service based on Kubernetes
Strong knowledge on cloud platform management & related cloud services, using Terraform
Familiarity with CI/CD tools like GitLab CI
Experience with configuration management tools like Ansible, Puppet, or Chef
Proficiency in scripting (e.g., Python, Ansible) for automation tasks
Proficiency in using version control systems, particularly Git
Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools like Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack
Knowledge of security best practices, including vulnerability scanning and access control
 Qualifications: 
Minimum 5 years of experience in a DevOps role, particularly within a cloud environment
Experience with public cloud platform is required, Google Cloud Platform (GCP) is highly preferred
Experience in production support on high scale & critical services, using Kubernetes
Strong understanding of DevOps methodologies and best practices
Excellent communication and leadership skills
Problem-solving and troubleshooting mindset
Passion for leveraging cutting-edge technologies to drive innovation
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment
 Perks & Benefits 
 At Worldline you’ll get the chance to be at the heart of the global payments technology industry and shape how the world pays and gets paid. On top of that, you will also:
Hybrid Working Policy
Gift vouchers on the occasion of Christmas/Easter Holidays
Private medical services
21 vacation days/year
Referral bonuses for new hires recommended by you
WFH & Flexible Working Hours
Full access to the “Learning” platform
 Shape the evolution 
 We are on an exciting journey towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers, people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you'll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. With an empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career - wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of 18,000 innovators and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own.
 Learn more about life at Worldline at jobs.worldline.com
 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as an individual with a disability, or any applicable legally protected characteristics.
